fact: Bank of Ghana stated on 20 March 2025 that MobileMoney Limited (MTN MoMo) is not licensed or authorised to conduct cross-border transactions, and that it approved Brij Fintech Ghana to test the BrijX Cedi-Naira currency swap in its regulatory sandbox, with live testing from February 2025.
title: Notice No. BG/GOV/SEC/2025/07: Pilot of BrijX by Brij Fintech Ghana in the Bank of Ghana Regulatory Sandbox
